question: The Bidar Fort is located in which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bidar Fort is a historical fort situated in the Bidar district of the state of **Karnataka**, India.
 
• The fort was built by Sultan Alla-Ud-Din Bahman of the Bahmani Dynasty in the 15th century.
 
• The fort is renowned for its architectural brilliance and is a prime example of Persian and Indian architectural styles.
 
• Bidar Fort includes several monuments within its complex, such as the Rangin Mahal, Gagan Mahal, and Takht Mahal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bahmani Sultanate:**

 
 
• The Bahmani Sultanate was a Muslim state of the Deccan in South India and one of the great medieval Indian kingdoms.
 
• It was established in 1347 by Ala-ud-Din Bahman Shah.
 
• The Bahmani Sultanate is known for its contributions to art, architecture, and culture.
 
 
 
• **Architectural Style:**
 
 
• The Bidar Fort exhibits a blend of Persian and Indian architectural styles.
 
• The use of colored tiles and intricate carvings are notable features of the fort's architecture.
 
 
 
• **Historical Significance:**
 
 
• Bidar Fort played a crucial role in the history of the Deccan region and was a strategic military and political center.
 
• It served as the capital of the Bahmani Kingdom and later the Barid Shahi dynasty.
 
 
 
• **Tourism:**
 
 
• Today, Bidar Fort is a popular tourist attraction, drawing visitors interested in history and architecture.
 
• The fort offers panoramic views of the surrounding area and insights into the region's historical past.
